title: Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU)
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating how an ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations on binary data, the fundamental computational component in all CPUs.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Computer Architecture
Digital Logic
CPU Design
Binary Arithmetic
Boolean Logic
learningObjectives: Identify the ALU's two input registers, operation selector, and result output as the computational core of a CPU
Calculate the results of ADD and SUBTRACT operations on the values held in Register A and Register B
Distinguish the bitwise AND, OR, and XOR operations by how each combines the corresponding bit pairs of the two registers
Convert register values between decimal and binary using the display toggle to inspect operations at the bit level
Predict the binary output of an operation before executing it, then verify against the simulator's result
